Remark
[Linearization with normal boundary condition] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0367, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0368 1. appk:K.43–K.44\group Harmonic Map Heat Flow

For a boundary-preserving variation $V$ of the identity, the two components of the linearization of the harmonic-map gauge map are \[ \left.\partial _s\right|_0(F_s^{-1})_*(\Delta _{g,g}F_s)=\Delta _gV+\operatorname {Rc}(V), \] \[ \left.\partial _s\right|_0(F_s^{-1})_*((F_s)_*N)_\top =([N,V])_\top =(\nabla _NV)_\top -\mathrm{II}(V). \]
